default/30556.htm.text: Master Toma: Who are you? I don't speak with those I do not know. Just go on!

Q00221_TestimonyOfProsperity/30556-01.ht.text: Master Toma: A donation ? Let me see... Is it already time for another donation? Strange indeed! It seems like just yesterday I gave one. This wouldn't be a trick from that rascal Arin? He is so full of himself since he became an Elder... Oh, well, I can't say no to your request... Here is the dona…
when: state STARTED; has items 3239,3246; lacks items 3262,3256,3251

Q00221_TestimonyOfProsperity/30556-02.ht.text: Master Toma: Stop bothering me! I gave you the donation , so take it and go! Give it to Arin, see if I'll care!
when: state STARTED; has items 3239,3246,3262,3256,3251; lacks items 3262,3251

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30556-01.html.text: Master Toma: Ha! Well I guess you caught me! Can't get anything past you... Don't misunderstand, I didn't steal it, I just borrowed it for a while to make the machine complete. If you want it back, please help me finish my test.

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30556-06.html.text: Master Toma: Ha, Don't be too mad. Now we know what to expect on our arrival! Now give me back the machine, not the broken one... Tell the old man that we broke 5 of them. Take care, then.
when: state STARTED; memo 3; has items 2916; lacks items 2871

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30556-07.html.text: Master Toma: Tell that old man that it broke too easily. Next time he should send something more durable.
when: state STARTED; memo 3; lacks items 2871,2916; item 2872 >= 5

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30556-01.html.text: Master Toma: Who are you? Oh, a letter from Mion? Hmm... So you want to be a Scavenger? Do just as I say. This body yearns for something sweet. What do you think? My friend says that if you kill a hunter bear, you can obtain an amazing honey. Please bring me just five Honey Jars . Knock down the Ho…

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30556-02.html.text: Master Toma: Shut up and bring me five Honey Jars at once! You're such an idiot! First you must kill the hunter bear . The Honey Bear will appear afterwards. Conquer the Honey Bear and search him with the spoil . Then you'll find the Honey Jars. You can find many hunter bears at the place where two…
when: state STARTED; has items 1653; lacks items 1646; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); !hasItemsAtLimit(player, HONEY_JAR)

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30556-03.html.text: Master Toma: Oh, mmm... mmm... Truly delicious ... This time, hunt some monsters. Go after the hunter tarantula or plunder tarantula and bring me the beads they're holding. Bring back at least twenty . And don't forget to take it out with spoil.
when: state STARTED; has items 1653; lacks items 1646; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); hasItemsAtLimit(player, HONEY_JAR)

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30556-04.html.text: Master Toma: Stop speaking to me. You must bring at least 20 beads . I am truly disappointed. Go back and catch hunter tarantulas or plunder tarantulas and poke around with a sweeper and quickly bring them to me.
when: state STARTED; has items 1654; lacks items 1646,1653; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); !hasItemsAtLimit(player, BEAD)

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30556-05a.html.text: Master Toma: A shining bead... Well done! You can complete the test by taking this to my friend. I owe so many of my friends... How will you choose one? Well, would you prefer one that is close or far away?
when: state STARTED; has items 1654; lacks items 1646,1653; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); hasItemsAtLimit(player, BEAD)

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30556-06a.html.text: Master Toma: It's for the Warehouse Keeper Route of Gludin Town. Hurry and deliver.
when: state STARTED; has items 1657; lacks items 1646,1653,1654,8543; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted())

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30556-06c.html.text: Master Toma: Take it to Yasheni, the Warehouse Chief in the Town of Schuttgart . Hurry up!

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30556-02.html.text: Master Toma: Good choice! Now, hold the machine and press this button! If you are transported to the Dwarven Village then it is a success! Let's try it!

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30556-03.html.text: Master Toma: You fool! Find me if you can!

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30556-04.html.text: Master Toma: Hey! That's unfair! Just help with the test and you'll get it back!

Q00231_TestOfTheMaestro/30556-05.html.text: Master Toma: Come back soon! Our next experiment awaits!

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30556-05b.html.text: Master Toma: A shining bead... Well done! You can finish the test by taking this to my friend Raut, a Warehouse Keeper in the Town of Gludin . Tell him I'm paying him back for the time he paid for my drinks. Good luck!

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30556-06b.html.text: Master Toma: A shining bead... Well done! You can finish the test by taking this to my friend Yasheni, a Warehouse Chief in the Town of Schuttgart . Good luck!
